purpose: R1a Web researcher subagent (WEB_SUBAGENT_PLAN v4 §4.2, §4.7) additive optional fields on SubagentSessionRegistry.Session: topic (first 80 chars of the first task prompt), webEvidence ([WebEvidenceRecord], one record per retrieval result with fetchedAt/toolCallId/servedFromCache/inContext), webQueriesUsed ([String]) and webReportCount (Int) — all nil for every non-Web session and absent from legacy files, which decode unchanged. ToolModels.swift changes are tool SCHEMAS only (web_query, web_extract, gated web_fetch refresh, Agent deliverable, subagent_manage kind), gated on the /websubagent switch; no persisted model in that file changed. Frozen P0 bytes and the R0 chronology fields are unchanged. Requires independent review with the R1a implementation.
